detours.why: Stern Hall's mapped doors open onto its inner courtyards and CERAS sits behind it to the west with no mapped path through the Stern courtyards, so the walk leaves Stern north to Escondido Mall and comes back round.

Schwab Residential Center's mapped entrance is on its north side and the GSB blocks fill the ground between it and the dining commons to the south-west, so the walk goes round by Serra Street and Campus Drive East.
